requests.summary: Guarantee 10 AM check-in on 13 Nov for Platinum member (BR-1088)

record.draft:
Dear Mr. Park,

Thank you for writing. I found your booking BR-1088 (Suite, Room 401), arriving Fri 13 Nov 2026 and departing Mon 16 Nov 2026.

Unfortunately, I can't guarantee a 10 AM check-in. Guaranteed early check-in is not offered at the Beach Resort [P1]. As a Platinum member, you get early check-in from 1:00 PM at no charge, subject to availability [P1]. Early check-in before the standard 3:00 PM depends on which rooms are ready and is never guaranteed at booking [P2].

If you'd like, we can note your arrival time on your booking so our front desk knows to prepare your room as early as possible. Our team will confirm what is available on the day.

Warm regards,
Guest Services, Beach Resort
